definition:
sequenceDiagram
  autonumber
  participant C as Client
  participant G as Gateway
  participant S as Service
  participant D as DB
  C->>G: POST /order
  activate G
  G->>S: validate(order)
  activate S
  loop each line item
    S->>D: check stock
    D-->>S: qty
  end
  alt all in stock
    S-->>G: 200 OK
  else short
    S-->>G: 409 Conflict
  end
  deactivate S
  Note over G,S: idempotency key retained 24h
  G-->>C: response
  deactivate G
intent: sequenceDiagram with participants, activations, loop, alt, and notes
